cooling_off.notes: Graduates-page FAQ read in full (13 questions listed, covering eligibility, deadlines, preparation, visa, relocation, data retention). No question or answer addresses reapplication, waiting periods, or assessment/math-test retakes. Nearest adjacent statement, verbatim: 'In line with GDPR regulations, we are permitted to store your data for up to 3 years after the date of your application.' That is a data-retention rule, not a cooling-off rule. Silence finding, not absence of check.
